summary: Iteration 34 - Verified photo multi-select/move/copy/clipboard flows + BUG2 (edit pencil + annotated photo tap-through) on WEB preview, mobile viewport 390x844. Seeded localStorage via add_init_script (idempotent flag) with settings (disclaimer accepted), two projects p1/p2, three photos ph1/ph2/ph3 (ph3 with annotation path), and photo_img_* data URIs. All 5 scenarios PASS: (1) Direct click on photo-edit-ph1 blue pencil navigates to /photos/annotate?photoId=ph1&projectId=p1 - BUG2 fix for normal photos works. (2) Tap on ph3's SVG body area (not on edit button) correctly bubbles through to parent TouchableOpacity and opens /photos/annotate?photoId=ph3 - BUG2 fix via Svg pointerEvents='none' works. (3) In 'Fotos auswählen' mode, both ph1 and the annotated ph3 are tappable for selection toggle (critical regression check for pointerEvents change); clicking Verschieben -> Projekt Zwei -> Ohne Ordner moved both ph1+ph3 to project_id='p2' while ph2 stayed in p1 (verified via localStorage.aufmassprofi_photos). (4) Copy ph2 to p2 produced a new photo entry with unique id in p2 plus its own photo_img_<newid> key; ph2 remained in p1 (total 4 photos). (5) 'Merken' writes aufmassprofi_photo_clipboard={photoIds:['ph2']}, green 'Fotos einfügen: 1 Foto' banner (testID photo-paste) appears on p2, clicking it duplicates the photo into p2 with new id + photo_img key and clears the clipboard key. No console errors beyond the pre-existing pointerEvents/shadow* deprecation warnings. Photo move/copy IS working on web - the user-reported iPad regression could not be reproduced on web and is likely either an outdated TestFlight build or a native-only interaction issue (not a logic bug in /app/frontend/app/projects/[id].tsx).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - affects the newly added Svg pointerEvents='none' and the sketch preview pointerEvents='none' in /app/frontend/app/projects/[id].tsx:3105. Current prop-based form still works on web; recommend migrating to style={{pointerEvents:'none'}} to future-proof against RN-Web removal.
'"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' - pre-existing, unrelated to this fix.

action_items: Fixes verified green on web - no code changes required. Main agent should push a new TestFlight build so the user can retest on iPad; the pencil-button and tap-through issues cannot be reproduced on web with the current code.

Optional cleanup: migrate the three pointerEvents='none' props on <Svg> and the sketch preview container to style.pointerEvents to silence the RN-Web deprecation and remain compatible with future RN-Web versions.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/projects/[id].tsx line 3197-3205: photo-edit overlay is a TouchableOpacity with testID=`photo-edit-${photo.id}` and hitSlop 8px on all sides - good, matches BUG2 fix.

Line 3102-3142: Annotated-photo <Svg> now has pointerEvents='none' so taps reach the parent TouchableOpacity (selection toggle or open editor). Verified: toggling selection on ph3 works and tap-on-body opens annotate editor.

Line 1046-1063 openTransferModal + 5921-5940 project rows: project rows DO have testID `move-target-${p.id}` (contrary to the review note that said 'testID-less'); using it is more robust than text matching.
Line 907-926 loadPhotoClipboard filters removed photos (good) and runs in useFocusEffect on [id] change (good) - clipboard banner correctly appears after navigation to another project.
seed_data_creation: localStorage seeded via Playwright add_init_script (idempotent via __test_seeded flag): aufmassprofi_settings (disclaimer accepted 2026-06), aufmassprofi_projects (p1 'Projekt Eins', p2 'Projekt Zwei'), aufmassprofi_photos (ph1, ph2, ph3 with annotation path 'M 10 10 L 100 100'), photo_img_ph{1,2,3} = 1x1 PNG data URI. Each scenario cleans/resets via the idempotent seed combined with the app's own mutations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To skip disclaimer on web, pre-set localStorage.aufmassprofi_settings = JSON {disclaimer_accepted_at:<ISO>, disclaimer_version:'2026-06'} (version constant lives in /app/frontend/src/components/DisclaimerGate.tsx line 8). Photos are stored in aufmassprofi_photos (JSON array of Photo objects without inline image_data) and per-photo image data in photo_img_<id> keys - PhotoService.getByProjectId merges them. Project rows in the transfer modal have testID move-target-<projectId> (not testID-less as earlier docs claimed). Folder step has testIDs folder-keep and folder-none. CRITICAL for Playwright with add_init_script: set an __test_seeded flag inside the init script to make it idempotent, otherwise every page.goto re-wipes the clipboard and photos state and tests fail spuriously. Preview URL: https://image-render-test.preview.emergentagent.com, mobile viewport 390x844. Backend is NOT used (offline-first app).
rca_of_issue: User-reported BUG2 (blue pencil edit button not reacting, tap next to it opening editor) is FIXED and verified: (a) photo-edit overlay is now a TouchableOpacity with hitSlop padding and an explicit onPress that navigates to /photos/annotate; (b) the annotated-photo <Svg> preview has pointerEvents='none' so taps on the image area pass through to the parent TouchableOpacity, which was the previous root cause of 'tapping beside the edit button' effectively working better than tapping on it (the Svg absorbed events on top of the parent). User-reported BUG1 (photo move/copy allegedly not working on iPad) cannot be reproduced on web - the full flow (select -> Verschieben/Kopieren -> target project -> folder step -> localStorage mutation) works end-to-end. If the iPad regression persists after a new TestFlight build, likely culprits to investigate on native: (i) Alert.alert dialogs on iOS blocking folder step confirmation unless user explicitly taps OK (code path uses Platform.OS==='web' alert vs Alert.alert - the native branch does alert() but the subsequent action may not fire if user dismisses too fast - inspect handleRememberPhotos line 942 and transferItemsToProject success alert), (ii) stale useFocusEffect reload on native not refetching photos after mutation, (iii) a native-only race between PhotoService.update and loadProjectData.
